sources.label: Manual oficial Chevrolet Tracker MY2027
sources.locator: Manual brasileiro MY2027, página impressa 271 (PDF 275), cobertura básica e Prazo de Garantia A/B: 36 meses para destinatário final de uso particular, sem teto de quilometragem; uso comercial tem limite de 100.000 km. Impressa 270 (PDF 274): início na entrega original; impressa 271: transferência ao novo proprietário preserva o término. Uso particular vem do ateste operacional existente da Netcar; vigência desta unidade e pedido de carimbo foram confirmados pelo responsável em 10/11/2026. O bônus condicionado não foi aplicado.

officialEvidence.pageNumberingNote: PDF page numbers here are physical one-based pages, verified locally; web extraction page labels are one less.

privateMileage.basis: Clause A specifies 36 months for final users without a mileage cap; clause B separately adds 100000 km for commercial/remunerated use. Same documentary interpretation as reviewed MY2026 Tracker20113; exact MY2027 clause independently verified.

manufacturerPolicy.generalWarrantyLocator: Printed p.271 / physical PDF p.275, general coverage paragraph and clauses A/B
manufacturerPolicy.coverageSummary: Base coverage for manufacturing/material defects in the vehicle and factory-installed equipment/accessories, subject to maintenance, natural-wear and other manual exclusions; not solely engine/transmission.
manufacturerPolicy.startBasis: Original delivery date to owner in the manual identification table, which prevails over other dates.
manufacturerPolicy.transferBasis: Rights automatically pass to subsequent owners through the original term end.
manufacturerPolicy.maintenanceConditions: Follow preventive servicing through authorized Chevrolet network; retain properly completed service documentation. Printed pp.270 and273 / physical PDF pp.274 and277.

conditionalBonus.reason: Requires normal use, prescribed authorized-network maintenance, acceptance of OnStar terms and active Standard Connect; materially narrower exclusions. No unit bonus eligibility documented.

manufacturerPolicy.notImportedFromOtherYears: MY2025 R8C/R8Z exceptions not imported; MY2026 serves as prior internal reference only, exact MY2027 manual supplies this policy.
